title: Going to the Cinema
subtitle: Story by Ted Kluck and Alli Horst · Pictures by Xiumin Zhang
author: Ted Kluck, Alli Horst

p01.scene: A spotlight glows over dark, empty rows of cinema seats.

p02.scene: Two film posters are taped to a wall: a yellow Kung Fu poster and a black-and-white Chaplin poster.

spots.name: Film poster
spots.desc: A yellow film poster that says Kung Fu, with a man holding a long stick.

spots.name: Chaplin poster
spots.desc: A black-and-white poster of Charlie Chaplin in a bowler hat.

p03.scene: A Cars poster is taped up beside the Chaplin poster, below the story text.

spots.name: Film poster
spots.desc: A Cars poster with a smiling red race car and the word Cars.

spots.name: Chaplin poster
spots.desc: The corner of the black-and-white Chaplin poster.

p04.scene: A boy cries in front of an actress in a big blue musical dress; a bearded man in a fur vest stands at the edge.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan is the little boy with spiky red hair, crying with his fists clenched.

spots.name: Musical actress
spots.desc: A dancer in a big light-blue dress, holding out a tissue.

p05.scene: A musical scene: a king and queen in a carriage, a dancer in a green costume, and a little man with a wand.

spots.name: King and queen
spots.desc: A king with a crown and a queen in a pink dress, riding in a carriage.

spots.name: Dancer
spots.desc: A dancer in a green costume and a frilly skirt, kicking one leg high.

p06.scene: In the dark cinema a nervous girl shrinks into her seat while the woman beside her tries to calm her.

spots.name: Scared girl
spots.desc: A little girl with a bow in her hair, squeezing her hands because she is scared.

spots.name: Woman
spots.desc: The woman next to her leans over to comfort her.

p07.scene: Dad leans back in his cinema seat with the big blue robot resting against him; a popcorn tub sits on the next seat.

spots.name: Dad
spots.desc: Dad wears glasses and a green cardigan.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: A big round blue robot with an antenna and round mechanical eyes.

spots.name: Popcorn
spots.desc: A tub of popcorn with the word popcorn on the box.

p08.scene: Kuan gives a thumbs-up next to the big blue robot, a tub of popcorn tucked under his arm.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: The big blue robot, taking up most of the seat.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan in his blue T-shirt gives a thumbs-up.

spots.name: Popcorn
spots.desc: A popping tub of popcorn that says POPCORN.

p09.scene: Kuan sits in his seat with a drink, a bald, bearded man with a newspaper beside him.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan sits in his seat holding a big red drink.

spots.name: Man with a beard
spots.desc: A big bald man with a black beard, reading in his seat.

p10.scene: Someone in a green cap plays the arcade machine; the screen shows the score 360.

spots.name: Arcade machine
spots.desc: An arcade machine with blocks on the screen and the score 360.

spots.name: Player
spots.desc: A boy in a green cap stands at the machine, playing.

p11.scene: Kuan pulls the big blue robot along and points up at the stand selling popcorn and drinks.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: The big blue robot is being pulled along by its arm.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan points up at the snack stand and grins.

spots.name: Snack stand
spots.desc: A stand selling popcorn and drinks, with the seller behind it.

p12.scene: A popcorn machine puffs out fresh popcorn above its big POPCORN sign.

spots.name: Popcorn machine
spots.desc: A glass popcorn machine full of yellow popcorn.

spots.name: POPCORN sign
spots.desc: A big sign on the machine that says POPCORN.

p13.scene: A snack counter loaded with popcorn tubs and cupcakes, with Superman and Iron Man posters and a woman in a red cap.

spots.name: Popcorn
spots.desc: Three boxes of popcorn lined up on the counter.

spots.name: Superman poster
spots.desc: A Superman poster with the words SUPER MAN and sugar.

spots.name: Snack seller
spots.desc: A woman in a red cap and striped apron, stacking the snacks.

p14.scene: The big blue robot fills the whole picture, its hands held out in front of it.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: The big round blue robot holds its hands up to its face.

p15.scene: Kuan grins and rubs his hands together, thinking about popcorn.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan rubs his hands together and grins at the idea of popcorn.

p16.scene: Kuan stands beside the tall blue robot and looks up at it.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: The blue robot stands beside Kuan, taller than he is.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan looks up at the robot with his hands behind his back.

p17.scene: Dad bends down, pointing a finger and talking.

spots.name: Dad
spots.desc: Dad with his glasses and green cardigan, bending down to point.

p18.scene: The robot's flat blue hand holds out banknotes and two gold coins.

spots.name: Money
spots.desc: Banknotes and two shiny coins held out in the robot's blue hand.

p19.scene: A child's hand holds out the banknotes and coins for the snacks.

spots.name: Money
spots.desc: A green banknote and gold coins in a child's hand.

p20.scene: The hall is dark; a bright line of screen light shines over the heads of the seated audience.

p21.scene: Rows of shadowy heads and cinema seats as the film plays.

p22.scene: Kuan gasps with his hand at his mouth, a popcorn tub hugged to his chest.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan stares wide-eyed at the screen with his hand at his mouth.

spots.name: Popcorn
spots.desc: A big tub of popcorn hugged against his chest.

p23.scene: We look past a seat back at the bright screen glowing in the dark.

p24.scene: On the screen, a purple car with big eyes and a toothy grin.

spots.name: Talking car
spots.desc: A purple car on the screen with eyes and a big toothy smile.

p25.scene: The screen shows a KARATE poster with a car in a headband, and the purple car beside it.

spots.name: KARATE poster
spots.desc: A poster on the screen that says KARATE, showing a car in a karate pose.

spots.name: Talking car
spots.desc: The purple talking car, pulling a grin beside the poster.

p26.scene: At the dinner table Dad reads the newspaper while Kuan lifts a toy car; the spotted dog begs beside him.

spots.name: Dad
spots.desc: Dad in a green spotted top, reading at the table.

spots.name: Kuan
spots.desc: Kuan in striped pyjamas lifts his blue toy car high.

spots.name: Dog
spots.desc: A white dog with big dark spots begs beside the table.

p27.scene: The blue robot sits at the dinner table in front of a bowl of soup, the girl in green looking at it.

spots.name: Robot
spots.desc: The blue robot sits at the dinner table with a bowl of soup.

spots.name: Soup
spots.desc: A white bowl of soup in front of the robot.

p28.scene: Dad is fast asleep, his head tipped back and his green sleeve resting on the seat.

characters.name: Kuan
characters.desc: The boy in the blue T-shirt with spiky red hair. He used to be afraid of films and is braver now.

characters.name: Dad
characters.desc: Kuan's dad, with curly red hair and glasses, usually in a green cardigan. He falls asleep in the cinema.
